title: Cardboard
body:
Get ready to farm a lot of sugar cane.

Cardboard is made from paper and can be crafted into Cardboard Blocks. These quick-breaking blocks have an absurdly high stack size of 1024, the highest in the game, which makes them useful for scaffolding or plotting out builds.
